messages:
jordan: Hey everyone — quick all-hands heads up for Friday 10:00am PT. Short agenda below and a couple logistics. Please drop questions in this thread or use the anonymous form (https://forms.redwood.internal/ah-questions). Need Qs in by Thursday 6pm PT. :calendar:

maya: Agenda (rough):
```
- 5m: Exec snapshot (Sam)
- 15m: Product roadmap & launches (Maya)
- 10m: Infra / reliability update (Devon)
- 8m: Policy & compliance note (Lee)
- 12m: Q&A (open)
- 5m: Takeaways + next steps
```

sam: Quick note — we'll flag the Dedicated rollout timeline and a customer partnership for Private deployments. Also calling out a short launch for the Optimize cost toolkit. Keep Qs concrete so we can action them. :sparkles:

devon: We'll demo the autoscale UI and a live telemetry panel. Engineering folks — confirm any blocking demo data by Thursday noon. @maya @alex? Also FYI: planned infra maintenance Wed 02:00-04:00 PT (no customer impact expected).

lee: There will be a small policy update about KMS rotation cadence and audit-log retention that we'll surface during the call. If you have customer-specific compliance questions, add them to the form or DM me.

emma: I'll publish slides and the recording after the all-hands. Recording + captions + transcript will be available here right after: https://redwood-internal/recordings/ah-2026-03-27 (placeholder). 

aaron: Can we get the transcript in an accessible format (SRT or plain text)?

jordan: yes — captions + transcript (SRT & plain text) will be attached to the recording.

alex: Note for teams on Dedicated trial: we'll call out upcoming billing alignment changes during the product segment. Product will send a targeted follow-up email to trial customers next week.

allhands-bot: Meeting created: All-hands — Fri 10:00am PT. Zoom link posted in #calendar. Automated reminder 30m before.

jordan: Thanks all — last call for Qs by Thu 6pm PT. If you'd rather remain anonymous, use the form above. See you Friday! :thumbsup:
